why: Back focuses an opener the surface no longer shows -- the Levels button after `setLevelSelect(1, 1)` hid it while the pane was up, or any title-only opener after a detach reshaped the menu. A hidden focused element strands a keyboard player with no visible position, which is the case the container fallback exists for. hud.navigation.test.ts (244): "Back falls back to the panel container when the opener was hidden while the pane was up".
